title: GraphSmith gateway-session chain entry (Track 1.2, SG-FR-5/SG-FR-7)
description: One record in the append-only, hash-chained gateway-session log -- modeled on schemas/retention-entry.schema.json's chain shape (see checks/register-retention.js), but a separate chain: gateway sessions are not adoption/retention records (Standalone Gateway TRD SS0's grounding finding). entry_sha256 is SELF-REFERENTIAL (computed from this entry's own other fields, see scripts/gateway/chain.js#computeEntrySha256), unlike retention-entry's packet_sha256 (an externally-supplied hash of a packet this entry merely retains) -- this is what lets SG-FR-7's verifier detect a mutated entry by recomputing its hash from its own content, not only by checking the next entry's prev_entry_sha256 link.

seq.description: Monotonic position in the chain, contiguous (append-only).

bundle_id.description: References the sealed bundle file this entry chains -- <state_dir>/gateway-sessions/<bundle_id>.json, unaffected by this schema.

prev_entry_sha256.description: null only for seq==1 (chain root); otherwise the prior entry's entry_sha256.

entry_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of this entry's own (schema_version, seq, bundle_id, prev_entry_sha256) tuple -- see scripts/gateway/chain.js#computeEntrySha256 for the exact canonical form.
